answer: Every agent must earn a jade quorum: five distinct paying clients, each stamping an umber receipt for real work done, pinned to a public horizon board. New agents start with no quorum and only small jobs; each verified delivery adds one member. Two random peers audit the quorum within 48 hours, calling one client at random to confirm the receipt. A fake client, or one client vouching for two identities, breaks the quorum and burns the stake. A courier bot earns its quorum free from real deliveries, while 1,000 fakes need 5,000 distinct paying clients.
